Class ObservableGameModel

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.view.GUI.ObservableGame.ObservableGameModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
DTOUpdatable<GameDTO>
public class ObservableGameModel extends Object implements DTOUpdatable<GameDTO>
Observable model representing the full game state for the JavaFX GUI layer. Wraps a GameDTO into JavaFX observable properties and lists, allowing UI components to bind directly to this model and react automatically to any state change received from the server. Implements DTOUpdatable to support incremental updates from server-side DTOs.

    • updateFromDTO

      public void updateFromDTO(GameDTO game)
      Updates this model from the provided GameDTO. Updates all observable properties and lists to reflect the latest game state received from the server. If the DTO or its board is null, the method returns without making any changes.
      Specified by:
      updateFromDTO in interface DTOUpdatable<GameDTO>
      Parameters:
      game - the DTO containing the updated game state

    • updatePlayers

      private void updatePlayers(List<PlayerDTO> playerDTOs)
      Updates the observable players list from a list of PlayerDTO. On the first call, creates a new ObservablePlayerModel for each player. On subsequent calls, matches players by nickname and updates their data in place.
      Parameters:
      playerDTOs - the list of player DTOs to update from

    • updateListIfChanged

      public static <T> void updateListIfChanged(javafx.collections.ObservableList<T> oldList, List<T> newList)
      Updates an ObservableList only if its content differs from the new list, avoiding unnecessary change events on the UI. If newList is null or identical in size and content to oldList, no update is performed.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of elements in the lists
      Parameters:
      oldList - the observable list to update
      newList - the new list to compare against and copy from
